{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows sustained negativity.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor to the immediate next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates > ±15% from recent 7-day average, adjust toward that average.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high sentiment (sentiment > 0.5) by scaling up the forecast by 5-10% for the next 3 days.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with a 30-day moving average filter.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.0) and price is trending upward, slightly increase forecast to capture momentum.",
    "When sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, slightly decrease forecast to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
